text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend overcame the pressure and was 
able to showcase her true running in the 
Leopard Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She negotiated directly with a billionaire 
to run in a thrilling race in Dubai, but 
unfortunately, it was not meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, since she managed a stable run 
this time, the Trainer decides she is 
ready to advance to the next hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking an even greater, unexpected 
thrill, Transcend set her sights on the GⅢ 
Miyako Stakes, where formidable rivals 
were sure to appear.
